bodyHtml:
🔍 We Diagnose, Explain & Solve · Logan & Surrounds

Hardware Repair & Diagnostics Logan. For When You're Not Sure What's Wrong.

Sluggish, broken or glitchy computer? We combine deep technical expertise with modern diagnostic tools to identify and fix issues quickly, either onsite or via secure remote access. No need to dismantle your setup or wait in a queue.

Diagnose My Hardware
✓ Onsite Or Remote
✓ No-Fix, No-Fee Option
✓ Windows & macOS
✓ Clear, Jargon-Free Explanations
Hardware Diagnostics & Repairs

Hardware Issues Can Lurk Undetected For Months.

Silently degrading performance and increasing the risk of failure, we identify faulty components before they take your whole system down.

🔧

Motherboard Faults

Including capacitor failures and BIOS issues.

🎮

Graphics Card Failures

NVIDIA and AMD GPU diagnostics for display crashes, artefacts or lag.

🔌

Power Supply Problems

Voltage irregularities and PSU replacements.

🧠

Failing RAM

Memory leaks and faults across Crucial, Corsair and G.Skill modules.

💾

Dead Or Failing Drives

Western Digital, Seagate, Kingston and Samsung storage diagnostics.

🌡️

Overheating & Fan Issues

Thermal re-pasting, dust removal and cooling upgrades.

We test hardware using tools like MemTest86, CrystalDiskInfo and HWMonitor, plus in-house bench testing, to confirm the issue before any repair goes ahead.

Software Troubleshooting

System Instability & Sluggish Performance.

Usually caused by software conflicts, OS errors or corrupted system files. We fix Windows boot errors, macOS kernel panics, corrupted registries and Blue Screen of Death crashes using SFC, DISM, Clean Boot and Safe Mode diagnostics, without unnecessary reinstalls or data loss.

Network & Connectivity

Slow Or Dropping Internet Connection?

We solve WiFi that won't connect or drops frequently, LAN port and router compatibility issues, NBN modem faults, and driver conflicts after OS updates, optimising your router configuration and re-establishing a stable, high-speed connection.

Virus & Malware Removal

Suspicious Pop-Ups Or Ransomware Alerts?

We scan and eliminate viruses, trojans, spyware, rootkits and keyloggers, install and configure antivirus software, remove browser hijackers, and restore corrupted system files, ensuring your system is clean and protected against reinfection.

PC Performance Optimisation

Computers Slow Down Over Time.

We uninstall bloatware, clean up startup processes, defragment hard drives, optimise SSDs, and upgrade RAM or storage, see our hardware installs & upgrades page for details. Older systems can often feel brand new again.

What Our Customers Say

Real Reviews From Real Customers.

"Terrific service, very affordable, has fixed my problems every single time, I've already recommended him to friends of mine."

"Fantastic service. Fixed our PC issues easily and gave great explanations on how to prevent issues in the future, plus lots of tips."

"Highly professional and very alert to my computer problems. Very highly recommended."

Why Choose Us

We Think Like Engineers, Not Salespeople.

When your computer's acting up and you're not even sure what's causing it, that's exactly what we specialise in.

  • Deep-level troubleshooting. We test components individually and analyse system logs rather than stopping at a basic virus scan.
  • Clear explanations, no geek speak. You'll understand what's wrong, what needs fixing, and why.
  • No-fix, no-fee option available. On eligible diagnostics, so you won't pay unless we can help.
  • Honest diagnostics. If your system's fine, we'll tell you. We won't sell you a repair you don't need.
Related Services

Already Know What's Broken?

If it's a laptop, head to laptop repairs or, for desktops and general faults, computer repairs. Suspect it's just a virus? See virus & spyware removal. Want your PC running like new without hardware issues? Check our computer tune-up service. And if diagnostics turn up a part that needs replacing, we handle hardware installs and upgrades too.

Not Sure What's Wrong With Your Computer?

Book a diagnostic and we'll find the real cause, not just the symptom.

Diagnose My Hardware
